summary: Aegon Ltd. via its subsidiary Aegon Funding Company LLC priced USD 500 million of senior unsecured notes (5.625% coupon, 10-year tenor) to fund a concurrent tender offer for certain unregistered subordinated notes, restricted to eligible non-US holders. The new notes are guaranteed by Aegon Ltd., expected to settle May 7, 2026, and will be listed on the NYSE. No specific price, premium, or terms for the tender were disclosed. Watch for tender offer details and completion of the concurrent liability management exercise.
